conclusions: All six terminal normal VM failures occurred before any new Managed case, before the first Setup metadata.
Both one-vCPU and original two-vCPU configurations failed; evidence does not identify vCPU count as root cause.
Direct uhubctl off/on returned success and all four re-enumerated, but true SoC cold boot was not established.
Firmware111 files are frozen inputs; no successful current runtime version query/upload occurred in these six trials.
Kernel/production Rust unchanged; prior sealed RF paths and evidence remain intact.

An exact one-device guest USB reset and an EHCI virtual controller also did not restore EP02 register-read OUT. Common QEMU/libusb or physical/device faults remain possible; no native-host execution was performed.
SDK class/interface request2 DISALLOW_TO_SLEEP=0 completed with four bytes and actual capture, but did not restore EP02 register-read OUT. PM wakeup alone does not solve this failure.

SDK asynchronous EP02 setup and EP82 IN were both really submitted, then cancelled with status -2 after the bounded wait. No register read value or SoC reset write. Ordering alone did not restore this VM/device state; host peers remained enumerated, which is not active Ready isolation.

The diagnostic VM preserved failure phase17 (RECOVERY_WAIT_CLOSE), -110, tx_sequence0, invalid metadata, and attempts2/limit2/exhausted1; this locates the failed handshake stage, not the natural fault root cause. Unknown command/hardware-error fields remain raw sentinel100.

Exact reference BSLE queue10 selection on EP01 also timed out before assembly reset or module load. EP01/EP02 negatives and EP0 control success identify observed transport behavior only; physical device/firmware, power and common QEMU/libusb remain unresolved.
